annotations.title: List artifacts (flyers and other non-deck form factors)

description: List every non-deck artifact you own — flyers, pages, t-shirts and brochures — with its id, kind and title, newest first. Pass kind to filter (e.g. kind:"flyer"). Decks are listed by list_decks; this is the sibling reader for everything on the shared artifacts spine.

kind.description: Filter to one kind, e.g. "flyer". Omit to list every kind.
